findings.title: A deferral is returned where the facts are whole
findings.message: `decide` returns `defer` when `checks` is an empty list, which is a whole read of no check. Input: facts with `checks: []` and every other fact readable.

findings.title: The change's description names a test that is not in it
findings.message: The description says `test_an_empty_list_is_whole` holds the rule; no test of that name is added.
